purpose: Continuously render pinned approval-pending translations in a disposable committed snapshot while preserving actual publication inputs/output.

isolation.snapshot: git archive HEAD; untracked and uncommitted changes excluded; exact sourceCommit reported.
isolation.fixtures: Synthetic schema-compatible approval fields explicitly deny human approval; fixture PR number is Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, not a real review PR.
isolation.cleanup: Temporary snapshot removed on normal completion and ordinary exceptions; OS/process forced termination not guaranteed.
isolation.protection: SHA256 tree fingerprints before/after; detect concurrent edits without overwriting them.
isolation.ciArtifact: Preview precedes upload; only unchanged normal dist is uploaded.

review.method: Self AI code review, failure/isolation regression tests and actual isolated build; no independent or human review.
limits: Reuses pinned translation drafts and stored AI/source-evidence reviews; no new semantic/native-language review or live source-fact recheck.
Preview dates and counts are synthetic and are not publication, indexing or ranking evidence.
Translation-language RSS verifier explicitly fails if non-translation entries need new date rules.

publication: New review PR only. PR82 was separately authorized and deployed; this change does not publish any waiting translations.
